question: How many students failed at least one course?

plan.reason: The question can be answered by counting students with at least one failing grade.
steps: Find all students who have at least one enrollment with a grade below 60 (excluding NULL grades), returning their ids and names.
Find all students who have at least one enrollment with a grade below 60 (excluding NULL grades), returning their ids and names.

changes.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT students.id, students.name
FROM students
JOIN enrollments ON students.id = enrollments.student_id
WHERE enrollments.grade IS NOT NULL AND enrollments.grade < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT students.id, students.name
FROM students
JOIN enrollments ON students.id = enrollments.student_id
WHERE enrollments.grade IS NOT NULL AND enrollments.grade < 60
LIMIT 200
